skills.name: autopilot
skills.description: Plan a task through conversation into plan.md, then keep the agent from stopping via a Stop hook until every Done When criterion and every todo is checked.
skills.short_description: Plan into plan.md, then use a Stop hook to keep the agent going until every checkbox is ticked.
skills.default_prompt: Use $autopilot to talk through the task into plan.md (goal, scope, done-when, detailed todos). When execution starts, a Stop hook checks plan.md each time the agent tries to stop and forces it to continue as long as unchecked items remain.

skills.name: webp
skills.description: Use demoon84/webp-maker to convert image files to WebP or build animated WebP assets from folders of frames.
skills.short_description: Run webp-maker to create static or animated WebP assets.
skills.default_prompt: Use $webp to run demoon84/webp-maker for WebP conversion, animated WebP generation, or full pipeline processing.
